<a id="page-lists"></a>
# Lists, grids, tables and repeated data

<a id="lists-when-to-use"></a>
## When to use

Anything repeated from data: lists and grids from one item template, nested lists (`item`, `index`, `parent`),
equal-height card grids, tables, carousels (`pageView`), list tiles, pagination, pull to refresh, swipe actions and
reordering.

<a id="lists-minimal-example"></a>
## Minimal example

A `listView` repeats its first child once per item of its `data` binding; inside, `${item}` is the item and
`${index}` its position:

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "roots": ["faq"],
  "nodes": {
    "faq": {
      "type": "canvas",
      "slots": {"body": "col"},
      "layout": {"width": 390, "height": 600},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFFFFFFF"}]}
    },
    "col": {
      "type": "column",
      "children": ["heading", "items"],
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": {"fill": 600}, "padding": 24},
      "props": {"spacing": 12, "crossAxisAlignment": "start", "scrollable": true}
    },
    "heading": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 30}},
      "props": {"text": "Questions", "style": {"fontSize": 24, "fontWeight": 700, "color": "#FF111827"}}
    },
    "items": {
      "type": "listView",
      "children": ["item"],
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 300}},
      "props": {"scrollable": false, "spacing": 8},
      "bind": {"data": "${questions}"}
    },
    "item": {
      "type": "column",
      "children": ["q", "a"],
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 60}, "padding": 12},
      "props": {"crossAxisAlignment": "start", "spacing": 4},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFF3F4F6"}], "radius": 8},
      "actions": [
        {
          "trigger": {"type": "click"},
          "actions": [{"type": "setVariable", "variable": "open", "value": "${= open == index ? -1 : index}"}]
        }
      ]
    },
    "q": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 318}, "height": {"hug": 20}},
      "props": {"text": "${item.q}", "style": {"fontSize": 16, "fontWeight": 600, "color": "#FF111827"}}
    },
    "a": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 318}, "height": {"hug": 20}},
      "props": {"text": "${item.a}", "style": {"fontSize": 14, "height": 1.4, "color": "#FF4B5563"}},
      "bind": {"visible": "${= open == index}"}
    }
  },
  "variables": {
    "faq": [
      {"name": "open", "type": "integer", "value": -1},
      {
        "name": "questions",
        "type": "list",
        "value": [
          {"q": "Can I cancel any time?", "a": "Yes. Your plan stays active until the end of the period."},
          {"q": "Do you offer refunds?", "a": "Within 14 days of purchase, no questions asked."},
          {"q": "Is there a free trial?", "a": "Every plan starts with 30 days free."}
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## Reference

<a id="node-listView"></a>
### `listView`

Flutter `ListView`; the first child is the item.

Flutter `ListView`: its first child repeated per item.

- Children: `children` and slots: `loading`, `error`, `end`, `sectionHeader`, `reorderPlaceholder`.
- Decoration: none: only blur effects in `decoration.effects` apply.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scrollDirection` | [Axis](values.md#enum-Axis) | `"vertical"` | `horizontal`, `vertical` | The axis it scrolls along. |
| `reverse` | bool | `false` |  |  |
| `physics` | [ScrollPhysicsType](values.md#enum-ScrollPhysicsType) | `"platform"` | `platform`, `bouncing`, `clamping`, `never`, `rangeMaintaining` |  |
| `alwaysScroll` | bool | `true` |  | Scrolls even when the content fits (`AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics`). |
| `primary` | bool | `false` |  |  |
| `keyboardDismissBehavior` | [KeyboardDismissBehavior](values.md#enum-KeyboardDismissBehavior) | `"manual"` | `manual`, `onDrag` |  |
| `clipBehavior` | [Clip](values.md#enum-Clip) | `"hardEdge"` | `none`, `hardEdge`, `antiAlias`, `antiAliasWithSaveLayer` |  |
| `itemCount` | int | unset |  | The number of items; null repeats the item without end (or one per value of the bound `data`). |
| `cacheExtent` | double | unset | ≥ 0 |  |
| `query` | Object | `{}` |  | Where the items come from in a running app: a cloud query (`{"collectionPath", "limit", "whereFilters", "orderByFilters", "paging", "loadRelated", "statusVariable"}`). Runtime only. |
| `scrollable` | bool | `true` |  | False builds every item without a viewport when the count is known and the list hugs its items (or stretches them across a cross axis it hugs). |
| `itemExtent` | double | unset | ≥ 0 | Each item's extent along the scroll direction. |
| `separator` | [ListSeparator](values.md#enum-ListSeparator) | `"none"` | `none`, `space`, `divider` |  |
| `spacing` | double | `0` |  | The separator's extent; negative overlaps the items. Without a `separator` it is empty space (as a row's or column's spacing). |
| `dividerThickness` | double | `1` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `dividerColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | `"#FF000000"` |  |  |
| `dividerIndent` | double | `0` |  |  |
| `dividerEndIndent` | double | `0` |  |  |
| `layout` | [ListLayout](values.md#enum-ListLayout) | `"list"` | `list`, `stack`, `deck` |  |
| `reversePaintOrder` | bool | `false` |  | Paints a layered list's items in the opposite order. |
| `itemPosition` | [Offset](values.md#type-Offset) | unset |  | A `ListLayout.stack` list: where the item sits in the padded box when its x/y aren't bound. |
| `wrap` | bool | `false` |  | Lays every item out in runs, as Flutter `Wrap`, each item at its own size. The runs go along `scrollDirection`: with the default `vertical` the items flow top to bottom and wrap into columns; for items side by side that wrap onto new rows set `"scrollDirection": "horizontal"`. For cards in equal columns from data, a `gridView` with `minCrossAxisExtent` is usually what is wanted. |
| `wrapSpacing` | double | `0` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `runSpacing` | double | `0` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `wrapAlignment` | [WrapAlignment](values.md#enum-WrapAlignment) | `"start"` | `start`, `end`, `center`, `spaceBetween`, `spaceAround`, `spaceEvenly` |  |
| `wrapCrossAlignment` | [WrapCrossAlignment](values.md#enum-WrapCrossAlignment) | `"start"` | `start`, `end`, `center` |  |
| `stretchItems` | bool | `false` |  | Every item as thick across the list as the thickest beside it. |
| `pagination` | [Pagination](lists.md#type-Pagination) | unset |  | Loads the items page by page, with pull to refresh (its footers are the `loading`, `error` and `end` slots). |
| `reorder` | [ListReorder](lists.md#type-ListReorder) | unset |  | Lets the user drag the items to a new place. |
| `sections` | [ListSections](lists.md#type-ListSections) | unset |  | Groups the items under headers (the `sectionHeader` slot). |
| `swipeActions` | [SwipeActions](lists.md#type-SwipeActions) | unset |  | Actions revealed behind a swiped item. |
| `pullToRefresh` | bool | `false` |  | Pulling the list past its start fires its `refresh` reactions (a `reloadCloudData`), with or without `pagination` (which reloads its first page too). A list with a `refresh` reaction refreshes this way too. |
| `stickToEnd` | bool | `false` |  | Opens at the end, keeps its place when items are put before, follows new items at the end. |

| `itemCount` | int | unset |  | The number of items; null repeats the item without end (or one per value of the bound `data`). |
| `cacheExtent` | double | unset | ≥ 0 |  |
| `query` | Object | `{}` |  | Where the items come from in a running app: a cloud query (`{"collectionPath", "limit", "whereFilters", "orderByFilters", "paging", "loadRelated", "statusVariable"}`). Runtime only. |
| `crossAxisCount` | int | `2` | ≥ 1 | A fixed number of columns (of rows when the grid scrolls sideways). For as many columns as fit, use `minCrossAxisExtent` instead. |
| `maxCrossAxisExtent` | double | unset | ≥ 0 |  |
| `minCrossAxisExtent` | double | unset | ≥ 0 | CSS grid `repeat(auto-fit, minmax(<min>, 1fr))`: as many equal columns as fit at least this wide (with `crossAxisSpacing` between), never more than there are items. Wins over `crossAxisCount` and `maxCrossAxisExtent`. `280` puts three cards across at 900 px, two at 600 and one at 390, with no breakpoints. |
| `mainAxisSpacing` | double | `0` |  | The gap between rows (along the scrolling axis), in pixels. |
| `crossAxisSpacing` | double | `0` |  | The gap between columns, in pixels. |

### `pageView`

Flutter `PageView`; the first child is the page.

Flutter `PageView`: its first child repeated per page.

- Children: `children`.
- Decoration: none: only blur effects in `decoration.effects` apply.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scrollDirection` | [Axis](values.md#enum-Axis) | `"vertical"` | `horizontal`, `vertical` | The axis it scrolls along. |
| `reverse` | bool | `false` |  |  |
| `physics` | [ScrollPhysicsType](values.md#enum-ScrollPhysicsType) | `"platform"` | `platform`, `bouncing`, `clamping`, `never`, `rangeMaintaining` |  |
| `alwaysScroll` | bool | `true` |  | Scrolls even when the content fits (`AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics`). |
| `clipBehavior` | [Clip](values.md#enum-Clip) | `"hardEdge"` | `none`, `hardEdge`, `antiAlias`, `antiAliasWithSaveLayer` |  |
| `itemCount` | int | unset |  | The number of items; null repeats the item without end (or one per value of the bound `data`). |
| `pageSnapping` | bool | `true` |  |  |
| `padEnds` | bool | `true` |  |  |
| `keepPage` | bool | `true` |  |  |
| `initialPage` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `viewportFraction` | double | `1` | ≥ 0.0001 |  |
| `allowImplicitScrolling` | bool | `false` |  |  |
| `animationDuration` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | How long a change of the bound page index animates, in ms (0 jumps). |
| `animationCurve` | String | `"easeOutCubic"` |  | The curve of that animation, by `Curves` name. |
| `pageMotion` | [Pose](values.md#type-Pose) | unset |  | A 3D look for the pages as they scroll (coverflow, cube, carousel): the motion a page has one page after the current one. The current page is at rest, pages between are interpolated by their distance (clamped to two pages) and pages before are mirrored (`translateX`, `shiftX`, `rotate`, `rotateY` and the alignment's x change sign). A `Pose`: a transform with an opacity and a blur. Null: flat pages. |
| `pageMotionBefore` | [Pose](values.md#type-Pose) | unset |  | The motion a page has one page *before* the current one, when the two sides differ (a book: the page leaving turns over about the spine, `{shiftX: 1, rotateY: -100, alignment: [-1, 0]}`, while the next one lies still beneath it, `pageMotion: {shiftX: -1}`). Interpolated by distance like `pageMotion` and not mirrored. Null: `pageMotion` mirrored. |
| `paintOrder` | [PagePaintOrder](values.md#enum-PagePaintOrder) | `"forward"` | `forward`, `reverse` | Which pages draw on top where they overlap: `forward` (Flutter's order: later pages over earlier ones) or `reverse` (earlier pages on top, so a page turning away covers the one it reveals). Taps reach the page on top first. |

<a id="node-tableView"></a>
### `tableView`

Flutter `TableView`; its slots are the cell templates.

Flutter's `TableView` (two_dimensional_scrollables): a table that scrolls on both axes, with a header row and column that stay pinned. Rows are the bound `data` (or `rowCount`); columns are `columns` (or bound `props.columns`). Its slots are templates built per cell with `${item}`: `cell` (`{value, row, column, rowIndex, columnIndex}`), `columnHeader` (`{label, column, columnIndex}`), `rowHeader` (`{row, rowIndex}`) and `corner`.

- Children: slots: `cell`, `columnHeader`, `rowHeader`, `corner`.
- Decoration: box decoration (fills, strokes, radius, shadows, clip).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `columns` | List<[TableColumn](lists.md#type-TableColumn)> | `[]` |  |  |
| `rowCount` | int | unset |  | The rows when no data is bound. |
| `rowHeight` | double | `40` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `rowHeightKey` | String | `""` |  | The field of a row (a map) that holds its own height, for rows that aren't all as tall (a summary row that grows with its content); rows without a number there are `rowHeight` tall. Empty: every row is. |
| `headerHeight` | double | `44` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `columnWidth` | double | `120` | ≥ 0 | A column's width unless it sets its own. |
| `rowHeaderWidth` | double | `120` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `fillWidth` | bool | `false` |  | Body columns grow to share the width the table has beyond all its columns' widths (equally), so a week fills a wide screen and still scrolls on a narrow one; no column is ever narrower than its width. |
| `pinHeaderRow` | bool | `true` |  |  |
| `pinHeaderColumn` | bool | `true` |  |  |
| `gridLineColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | `"#FFE0E2E8"` |  | The lines between cells; transparent for none. |
| `gridLineWidth` | double | `1` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `stripeColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  | Every other body row's background. |
| `headerColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  | The header row's and column's background. |
| `cacheExtent` | double | unset | ≥ 0 |  |
| `clipBehavior` | [Clip](values.md#enum-Clip) | `"hardEdge"` | `none`, `hardEdge`, `antiAlias`, `antiAliasWithSaveLayer` |  |
| `horizontalPadding` | double | `0` | ≥ 0 | Space before the first column and after the last. |
| `headerBorderColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  | A line under the header row only. |
| `headerBorderWidth` | double | `1` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `rowHoverColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  | A body row's background while the pointer is over it. |
| `selectedRow` | int | `-1` |  | The selected body row (bind it), -1 for none: drawn in `selectedRowColor` with a `selectedRowEdgeWidth` edge at its start in `selectedRowEdgeColor`. |
| `selectedRowColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  |  |
| `selectedRowEdgeColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  |  |
| `selectedRowEdgeWidth` | double | `4` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `stretchLastColumn` | bool | `false` |  | The last column takes the width the columns leave over, so the ruled rows run to the table's edge. |

<a id="node-pagination"></a>
### `pagination`

Page controls for a list's pagination.

Page controls for a list's pagination (found by its name, `controller`): first, previous, page numbers with ellipses (1 … 4 5 6 … 16), next, last, a page size select and a summary. Choosing a page fires the node's `changed` reactions with the page as `${result}`.

- Children: none.
- Decoration: none: only blur effects in `decoration.effects` apply.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `controller` | String | `""` |  | The `Pagination.name` of the list this shows and moves (an expression). |
| `showFirstLast` | bool | `true` |  |  |
| `showPrevNext` | bool | `true` |  |  |
| `showPageNumbers` | bool | `true` |  |  |
| `siblingCount` | int | `1` | ≥ 0 | Page numbers on each side of the current one before an ellipsis. |
| `boundaryCount` | int | `1` | ≥ 0 | Page numbers always shown at each end. |
| `showPageSize` | bool | `false` |  | A page size select, offering the pagination's `pageSizeOptions`. |
| `showSummary` | bool | `true` |  |  |
| `summaryText` | String | `"Showing {from}–{to} of {total}"` |  | `{from}`, `{to}`, `{total}`, `{page}`, `{pageCount}` are replaced; an unknown total shows as "many". |

<a id="behavior-reorderHandle"></a>
### `reorderHandle` (behavior)

A node key (beside `layout` and `props`). Type: bool. Default: `false`.

A reorderable list row's drag handle (`ReorderableDragStartListener`).

<a id="lists-triggers"></a>
### Triggers

Written as `"trigger": {"type": "<trigger>", ...}` in a reaction ([trigger fields](interaction.md#interaction-trigger-fields)).

| Trigger | When it fires |
|---|---|
| <a id="trigger-reorder"></a>`reorder` | A data list row was dragged to a new place by this node, its reorder handle (`${result.from}`, `${result.to}`). A list with a `reorder` fires it too, with `${result.item}`, `${result.fromList}`, `${result.toList}`. |
| <a id="trigger-refresh"></a>`refresh` | A list or grid was pulled past its start to refresh (its `pullToRefresh`, or its pagination's); its pagination reloads its first page too. A list with this reaction can always be pulled. |
| <a id="trigger-swipeAction"></a>`swipeAction` | A swipe action of a list item ran (the list's `swipeActions`): `${result.action}`, `${result.label}`, `${result.item}`, `${result.index}`. |
| <a id="trigger-rowTap"></a>`rowTap` | A table view's body row was tapped: `${result.row}` (the row's data), `${result.rowIndex}`, `${result.column}` (the tapped column's key), `${result.columnIndex}`. |

<a id="action-paginate"></a>
### `paginate` (action): Paginate

Moves the pagination controller of a list or grid (its `pagination`, by `controller`, the pagination's name).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `controller` | String | `""` |  | The pagination's name. |
| `command` | [PaginateCommand](values.md#enum-PaginateCommand) | `"next"` | `next`, `previous`, `goTo`, `first`, `last`, `refresh`, `retry`, `setPageSize` |  |
| `page` | String | `"1"` |  | For goTo: a number or an expression. |
| `pageSize` | String | `"20"` |  | For setPageSize. |

<a id="type-Pagination"></a>
### Pagination

A pagination controller: loads a list's items page by page and exposes its state as a map variable named `name` (`${name.items}`, `${name.page}`, `${name.pageCount}`, `${name.hasMore}`, `${name.isLoadingMore}`, `${name.error}`...). Paginate actions move it.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | String | `""` |  | The map variable that holds the state, unique on its page. |
| `mode` | [PaginationMode](values.md#enum-PaginationMode) | `"infinite"` | `pages`, `infinite`, `bidirectional` |  |
| `source` | [PaginationSource](values.md#enum-PaginationSource) | `"data"` | `data`, `cloud`, `api` |  |
| `pageSize` | int | `20` | ≥ 1 |  |
| `pageSizeOptions` | List<int> | `[10,20,50,100]` |  | The page sizes a pagination node offers; empty offers none. |
| `strategy` | [PaginationStrategy](values.md#enum-PaginationStrategy) | `"offset"` | `offset`, `page`, `cursor` |  |
| `keyPath` | String | `"id"` |  | The path in an item of the value that identifies it; items with the same value show once. Empty keeps every item. |
| `initialPage` | int | `1` | ≥ 1 | The page shown first, from 1. |
| `thresholdItems` | int | `5` | ≥ 0 | How many items from the end (or start) the next page starts loading. |
| `thresholdPixels` | double | `0` | ≥ 0 | The same in pixels of scroll left; 0 uses `thresholdItems` alone. |
| `cachePages` | bool | `true` |  | Loaded pages are kept to show again until a refresh. |
| `apiId` | String | unset |  | The API (`PaginationSource.api`). |
| `parameters` | Object | `{}` |  | The API call's parameters (`${page.page}`...). |
| `itemsPath` | String | `""` |  | Where in an API response the page's items, the total count and the next cursor are (empty: the response itself, unknown, none). |
| `totalPath` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `cursorPath` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `pullToRefresh` | bool | `false` |  | Pull to refresh (`RefreshIndicator`): the list's `refresh` reactions. |
| `refreshColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  |  |
| `refreshBackgroundColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  |  |
| `refreshDisplacement` | double | `40` | ≥ 0 |  |

<a id="type-ListSections"></a>
### ListSections

Groups a data list's consecutive items with the same `groupBy` value into sections, each under the list's `sectionHeader` slot.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `groupBy` | String | `""` |  | A path in the item (`group`, `date.day`) or an expression. |
| `sticky` | bool | `true` |  | The current section's header stays pinned until the next pushes it out. |
| `indexBar` | bool | `false` |  | An index of the sections' keys along the list's edge (A–Z). |
| `indexKeys` | List<String> | `[]` |  | The keys the index shows, in order (`A`…`Z`); empty shows the sections'. A key no item has is drawn in `indexMutedColor` and does nothing. With a data-paged list the keys of every item count, and picking one loads pages until its section is in. |
| `indexStyle` | [TextStyle](theme.md#type-TextStyle) | `{}` |  | The index's text (font, size, weight, color). |
| `indexActiveColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  | A key while it is touched. |
| `indexMutedColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  | A key no item has. |
| `indexWidth` | double | `20` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `indexBubble` | bool | `false` |  | The touched key pops up large beside the index while it is dragged. |
| `indexBubbleColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  |  |
| `indexBubbleStyle` | [TextStyle](theme.md#type-TextStyle) | `{}` |  |  |
| `indexInsets` | List<double> | `[0,0,0,0]` |  | Space between the index bar and the list's edges: left (unused), top, right, bottom. Zero sits it on the right edge, full height. |

<a id="type-ListReorder"></a>
### ListReorder

Dragging a list's items to a new place, within the list and, with a `group`, into other lists of the group (a Kanban board). A drop runs the list's `reorder` reactions with `${result.from}`, `${result.to}`, `${result.item}`, `${result.fromList}` and `${result.toList}`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | bool | `true` |  |  |
| `start` | [ReorderStart](values.md#enum-ReorderStart) | `"handle"` | `handle`, `longPress`, `press` |  |
| `group` | String | `""` |  | Lists of one group take each other's items; empty: within this list. |
| `listKey` | String | `""` |  | This list in `${result.fromList}` / `${result.toList}` (an expression); empty: the list's id. |
| `canReorderIf` | String | `""` |  | Must hold for an item (`${item}`, `${index}`) to be picked up. |
| `canDropIf` | String | `""` |  | Must hold for a drop (`${result}` as the drop would be). |
| `proxyElevation` | double | `6` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `proxyScale` | double | `1` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `proxyOpacity` | double | `1` | ≥ 0, ≤ 1 |  |
| `placeholder` | [ReorderPlaceholder](values.md#enum-ReorderPlaceholder) | `"gap"` | `gap`, `node` |  |
| `autoScroll` | bool | `true` |  |  |
| `autoScrollEdge` | double | `48` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `keyboard` | bool | `true` |  | A focused item moves with Alt and the arrow keys, and is announced. |
| `apply` | [ListApply](values.md#enum-ListApply) | `"none"` | `none`, `variable`, `cloud` |  |
| `orderField` | String | `"order"` |  | The numeric field of a document's position (`ListApply.cloud`). |
| `listField` | String | `""` |  | The field of the list a document is in, for moves between lists. |

<a id="type-SwipeAction"></a>
### SwipeAction

One action revealed behind a list item as it is swiped.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | String | `""` |  | The action in `${result.action}`. |
| `label` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `icon` | [IconData](values.md#type-IconData) | unset |  |  |
| `background` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | `"#FFDB2626"` |  |  |
| `foreground` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | `"#FFFFFFFF"` |  |  |
| `removes` | bool | `true` |  | Takes the item out of the list (delete, archive); otherwise it springs back. |
| `when` | String | `""` |  | Offered for an item only while this holds (an expression reading `${item}`, e.g. `${= item.done}`); empty: always. The first action of a side that holds is the one a full swipe runs. |
| `labelStyle` | [TextStyle](theme.md#type-TextStyle) | `{}` |  | The label's text (font, size, weight; its color is `foreground`). |
| `iconSize` | double | `22` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `inline` | bool | `false` |  | The icon beside the label instead of above it. |

<a id="type-SwipeActions"></a>
### SwipeActions

Swipe actions on a list's items (`Dismissible`): toward the start reveals `endActions`, toward the end `startActions`; past `threshold` the first of the side runs. Running one fires the list's `swipeAction` reactions with `${result.action}`, `${result.item}`, `${result.index}`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | bool | `true` |  |  |
| `startActions` | List<[SwipeAction](lists.md#type-SwipeAction)> | `[]` |  |  |
| `endActions` | List<[SwipeAction](lists.md#type-SwipeAction)> | `[]` |  |  |
| `threshold` | double | `0.4` | ≥ 0, ≤ 1 | The fraction of the item's width a swipe passes to run the first action. |
| `undo` | bool | `true` |  | An action that removes the item shows an Undo bar first. |
| `undoMs` | int | `4000` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `undoMessage` | String | `"${result.label}"` |  | `${result.label}` reads the action's label. |
| `apply` | [ListApply](values.md#enum-ListApply) | `"none"` | `none`, `variable`, `cloud` |  |
| `radius` | [BorderRadius](values.md#type-BorderRadius) | `0` |  | The revealed actions' corners (round them to match the item's). |
| `armedScale` | double | `1` | ≥ 0 | The action's label grows to this scale once a release would run it. |
| `armHaptic` | bool | `false` |  | A selection click when a swipe passes the threshold either way. |

<a id="type-TableColumn"></a>
### TableColumn

One column of a table view: the row field its cells show (`key`, read as `${item.value}`), its header text (`label`, `${item.label}`) and its width (null: the table's `columnWidth`).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `label` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `width` | double | unset | ≥ 0 |  |
| `flex` | double | `0` | ≥ 0 | The column's share of the room left when the table is wider than its columns (its width is then the least it takes); 0: fixed. |

<a id="lists-patterns"></a>
## Patterns

<a id="lists-one-template-from-data"></a>
### One template from data

A `listView` (or `gridView`, `pageView`) repeats its **first child** once per item of its `data` binding:
`"bind": {"data": "${questions}"}`. Inside the repeated child, `${item}` is the item (`${item.title}`) and
`${index}` its position from 0. A list in a scrolling page sets `"scrollable": false` so it lays out every item at
its full height; `spacing` separates items. Items fill the list's width. The item template can carry reactions: a
click on an item runs with that item's `item` and `index`. When the item is more than about five nodes, or appears
elsewhere too, make it one call of a [component](components.md#page-components) (`"bind": {"props.plan": "${item}"}`).

<a id="lists-a-grid-of-cards"></a>
### A grid of cards

For cards in columns from one list inside a scrolling page, use a `gridView` with `minCrossAxisExtent` (CSS
`repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr))`: as many equal columns as fit), `"shrinkWrapRows": true` and
`"physics": "never"` (it lays out every item and the page scrolls). A fixed number of columns: `crossAxisCount`. A
`listView` with `"wrap": true` lays its items out at their own sizes in runs along its `scrollDirection`: set
`"scrollDirection": "horizontal"` for chips or nav links side by side. In wrap mode the gap between items is
`wrapSpacing` and between runs `runSpacing`; `spacing` does not apply.

<a id="lists-equal-height-cards"></a>
### Equal-height cards

In a `gridView` with `"shrinkWrapRows": true` (CSS grid's auto rows) each row is as tall as its tallest item, and
every item is stretched to it, whether it hugs or fills its height. Make the item the card (the box with the
decoration): a card *inside* a hugging item column keeps its own height, and a card that fills the item's height
there takes its design number (`fill_fallback`). A banner above one card goes inside the card, with a top margin on
the others to line them up. A card's button pinned to its bottom: a `spacer` (or a `fill` height child) between the
content and the button inside the stretched card. `shrinkWrapRows` wins over `mainAxisExtent` (`prop_ignored`); for
rows at least n tall, give the item `"constraints": {"minHeight": n}`.

<a id="lists-nested-lists"></a>
### Nested lists

A list inside a list's item repeats per item of its own `data`, usually a field of the outer item. Inside the inner
template `item` and `index` are the innermost list's; `parent` is the item around it (`${parent.item}`,
`${parent.index}`, and its fields directly: `${parent.name}`). Two levels:

```json
"sections": {"type": "listView", "children": ["section"], "bind": {"data": "${= groupBy(dishes, 'section')}"},
             "props": {"scrollable": false, "spacing": 24}, "layout": {"width": {"fill": 600}, "height": {"hug": 400}}},
"section":  {"type": "column", "children": ["sectionTitle", "dishList"], "props": {"crossAxisAlignment": "start"},
             "layout": {"width": {"fill": 600}, "height": {"hug": 200}}},
"sectionTitle": {"type": "text", "props": {"text": "${item.key} (${item.count})", "style": {"fontSize": 20, "color": "#FF111827"}},
             "layout": {"width": {"hug": 200}, "height": {"hug": 24}}},
"dishList": {"type": "listView", "children": ["dish"], "bind": {"data": "${item.items}"}, "props": {"scrollable": false},
             "layout": {"width": {"fill": 600}, "height": {"hug": 120}}},
"dish":     {"type": "text", "props": {"text": "${parent.key} ${parent.index}: ${item.name} (#${index})", "style": {"color": "#FF374151"}},
             "layout": {"width": {"fill": 600}, "height": {"hug": 20}}}
```

A third level reads the second's item as `parent`; to reach further out, carry the value down in the data.

<a id="lists-a-table-from-one-template"></a>
### A table from one template

A `listView` of rows bound to the records, each row a label and a `gridView` of cells bound to `${item.values}` with
`crossAxisCount` the number of columns: one cell node for every column (the example in
[a capped band](layout.md#layout-a-capped-band)). Four columns written by hand, or four lists side by side, are the same
table written four times. For a column that stays while the others scroll sideways, keep the label column a
`listView` of its own beside one horizontally scrolling block of the cell grids, rows the same height in both. A
`tableView` is a data table with columns declared once (sorting, row taps).

<a id="lists-a-weekly-grid"></a>
### A weekly grid

Seven columns of days from data: a `gridView` with `"crossAxisCount": 7` bound to the days (`${= range(7)}`, or a
computed list of `{day, done}` records), each cell a box whose fill is bound to the item. Rows of habits × days: a
`listView` of habits whose item holds a label and that 7-column grid bound to `${item.days}`; in a cell, `${parent}`
is the habit and `${index}` the day. A grid sizes its cells: set the cell height with `mainAxisExtent` and give
the cell `fill` on both axes (a fixed size is `fit_not_allowed`).

A tap on a day flips it in the habit's record (`setAt` and `set` build the new list); the label counts the checks:

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "roots": ["home"],
  "nodes": {
    "home": {
      "type": "canvas",
      "slots": {"body": "col"},
      "layout": {"width": 390, "height": 400},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFFFFFFF"}]}
    },
    "col": {
      "type": "column",
      "children": ["habitList"],
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": {"fill": 400}, "padding": 24}
    },
    "habitList": {
      "type": "listView",
      "children": ["habit"],
      "bind": {"data": "${habits}"},
      "props": {"scrollable": false, "spacing": 12},
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 200}}
    },
    "habit": {
      "type": "column",
      "children": ["name", "week"],
      "props": {"crossAxisAlignment": "start", "spacing": 6},
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 70}}
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "text",
      "props": {"text": "${item.name}: ${= count(item.days, d => d)}", "style": {"fontSize": 15, "color": "#FF111827"}},
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 20}}
    },
    "week": {
      "type": "gridView",
      "children": ["day"],
      "bind": {"data": "${item.days}"},
      "props": {"crossAxisCount": 7, "mainAxisExtent": 40, "crossAxisSpacing": 6, "physics": "never"},
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 40}}
    },
    "day": {
      "type": "box",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 40}, "height": {"fill": 40}},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFE5E7EB"}], "radius": 20},
      "bind": {"decoration.fills[0].color": "${= item ? '#FF16A34A' : '#FFE5E7EB'}"},
      "actions": [
        {
          "trigger": {"type": "click"},
          "actions": [
            {
              "type": "setVariable",
              "variable": "habits",
              "value": "${= setAt(habits, parent.index, set(parent.item, 'days', setAt(parent.item.days, index, !item)))}"
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  },
  "variables": {
    "home": [
      {
        "name": "habits",
        "type": "list",
        "value": [
          {"name": "Water", "days": [true, true, false, false, false, false, false]},
          {"name": "Read", "days": [false, true, false, false, false, false, false]}
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

<a id="lists-a-carousel-pages-and-pagination"></a>
### A carousel, pages and pagination

A `pageView` shows one item (or child) per page and swipes between them (`viewportFraction` below 1 shows the
neighbours' edges; `initialPage`). Long lists that load in pages: the list's `pagination` settings, with a
`pagination` control or the `paginate` action to move between pages.

<a id="lists-pitfalls"></a>
## Pitfalls

- Only the first child is the template; other children are ignored.
- `item` and `index` are the innermost list's; the outer one is `parent`.
- A list inside a scrolling page needs `"scrollable": false` (or `"physics": "never"`, which a `gridView` needs:
  it has no `scrollable`), or it takes its design height and scrolls inside itself.
- A wrapping `listView` runs along its `scrollDirection`: with the default `vertical` it flows top to bottom into
  columns (`vertical_wrap`).
- Decoration on a `listView` or `gridView` is ignored (`decoration_ignored`): put the list inside a column that has
  it.
- A `fill` height inside a hugging grid item is its design number (`fill_fallback`).
- A slot inside a list of a component shows what the call passes in every item, built in the caller's scope: it
  reads the caller's variables, not the item.
